definitions.explanation: Living for many years; having a long lifespan.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{長生|ながい}きした。
examples.english: My grandmother lived a long life.

examples.japanese: {長生|ながい}きの{秘訣|ひけつ}は{何|なん}ですか。
{健康|けんこう}で{長生|ながい}きしたい。
examples.english: I want to live a long, healthy life.

notes:
COMPOUND: {長|なが}い (long) + {生|い}き (living)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {長生|ながい}きする (to live long)
- {長生|ながい}きの{秘訣|ひけつ} (secret to longevity)
- {健康|けんこう}{長寿|ちょうじゅ} (health and longevity)

RELATED TERMS:
- {寿命|じゅみょう} (lifespan)
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ} (longevity - more formal)
- {短命|たんめい} (short life)

Japan is known for having one of the longest life expectancies in the world, making {長生|ながい}き a culturally significant concept.
